answer: Sybil resistance comes from reputation weights that decay exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service rather than accumulated once and retained indefinitely. In the reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust graph, a freshly spawned identity has few trusted incoming paths and near-zero eigenvector centrality, making consensus thresholds unreachable by merely multiplying identities—like a sparrow on an ocean ledge cannot manufacture trust.
